shortfalls.title: Repeated assignee filters return tickets that fail the second filter
Operators have no documented route from an agent name to a notification destination
The CLI displays an accepted assignee as unassigned
Unicode line breaks pass the single-line check and split raw CLI records
An accepted assignee can be impossible to filter for

choices.text: An impossible assignee search value, such as a 65-character name or a name with a tab, returns HTTP 200 with an empty page.
Lifecycle transitions retain the last assignee through resolution, closure, and reopening.
Unassigning creates no notification of its own.
A delayed assignment notice uses the ticket title as it was when the assignment was made
